item.title: Collision rating for 02/07/2026
item.description: Collision drew 388,000 viewers last Saturday night, down 104,000 viewers from the previous episode. The show had the same 0.07 rating in 18-49 as it did the prior week and was #27 on the top 50 cable chart for the night.
